recipes.oracle_text:
Choose a color. Creatures you control gain protection from the chosen color until end of turn.
Cycling {W} ({W}, Discard this card: Draw a card.)

recipe_coverage: Ordinary cycling component only, through the real hand-ability proxy/menu. Explicit pinned cycling cost, both players, discard and payment before stack resolution, ordered draws and multiplicities, independent copies, cancellation/insufficient or wrong mana, combat/opposing turn, own/opposing cost reduction and taxes, pending/resolved snapshots after AI backups, and reclaim/exile of the discarded source while the draw is pending. Cast effects, battlefield abilities and multiplayer remain gaps. Additional cycling/discard triggers, nonstandard cycling costs and alternate hand/graveyard mechanics are excluded.
